# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release of HCS.UmbCustomHeader receives security fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public issue for security problems.

Report it privately through GitHub instead: go to the repository's **Security** tab and choose
**Report a vulnerability**. You should get a response within a week. Once a fix is released,
the advisory will be published and you will be credited unless you would rather not be.
